**Square II:**  
The lines are
\[

They meet at \(x=\frac23,\ y=\frac13\). Thus
\[
S_{\mathrm{II}}=\frac12\cdot1\cdot\frac13=\frac16.
\]

y=1-2x \quad\text{and}\quad y=\frac{x}{2}.

\[
1-2x=\frac{x}{2}

\[
S_{\mathrm{III}}=\frac12\cdot1\cdot\frac25=\frac15.

\[
\frac16<\frac15<\frac13,
\]
we have
\[
S_{\mathrm{II}}<S_{\mathrm{III}}<S_{\mathrm I}.
